title: VPN Hunter from Lagos: Nigerian IP 102.220.160.200 (AS328528 NetIT-Solutions) Targeting /global-protect/login
content_md:
VPN Hunter from Lagos: Nigerian IP 102.220.160.200 (AS328528 NetIT-Solutions) targeting /global-protect/login endpoint. This IP was observed performing HTTP CVE probing against Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN login interfaces. The activity was detected by the CyberVeille honeypot (Infomaniak) on September 10, 2026 at 03:22 UTC. The source is consistent with opportunistic scanning for known VPN vulnerabilities.

via Mastodon https://cyberveille.ch/map/
